title: Sworn in at Fort Wingate
text: The first 29 Navajo Code Talkers were sworn into the Marine Corps at Fort Wingate, in McKinley County, on May 4, 1942. Fort Wingate sits about 15 miles east-southeast of Gallup. Nearly 400 Navajo Marines went on to serve as code talkers across the Pacific. In 2001, Congress awarded each of those first 29 recruits the Congressional Gold Medal.
